description: This file defines the AuditReadPlatformService interface, which provides methods for retrieving audit log entries and search templates in the Fineract project.

classes.name: AuditReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface providing methods for reading audit logs and search templates.

methods.name: retrieveAuditEntries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of audit data entries, with optional inclusion of JSON details, based on extra SQL criteria.

methods.name: retrievePaginatedAuditEntries
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of audit data entries based on extra SQL criteria, inclusion of JSON, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: retrieveAllEntriesToBeChecked
methods.description: Retrieves all audit data entries that need to be checked, based on extra SQL criteria and inclusion of JSON.

methods.name: retrieveAuditEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a single audit data entry by its audit ID.

methods.name: retrieveSearchTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a search template (AuditSearchData) based on a specified use type.
